'''Starfruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that contained a central core and five arms.<ref name="Legacy of the Force" /> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Betrayal Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> while on the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] investigating the [[Dammant Killers]] company, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Ben Skywalker]] encountered a [[Adumari fighter craft|starfighter]] that resembled a starfruit, with one central body and five arms protruding from it.<ref name="Legacy of the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
Starfruit was mentioned in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'', which was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and was released in [[2006]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force" /> In real life, the [[Wikipedia:Carambola|carambola]] is also known as a starfruit.<ref name="Starfruit">{{WebCite|url=https://www.farmersalmanac.com/what-the-heck-is-starfruit-10025|text=What the Heck is Starfruit?|work=[https://www.farmersalmanac.com Farmers' Almanac]|quote=Starfruit, or carambola, is a five-lobed yellow fruit native to Indonesia, India, and Sri Lanka, though it is now cultivated in tropical regions of both North and South America, as well.|archivedate=20220310025323}}</ref>
